pattern.description: The virtual camera pans right across a wide app canvas, sliding the agent plan off the left and settling on the diff panel with a slight zoom, then the cursor parks on the primary action.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous move connects the narration step 'test them out' to the next UI surface without a cut, keeping spatial continuity; the slight scale and eased settle feel like a directed camera instead of a screen recording.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.canvas', {x: 0, scale: 1}, {x: '-55%', scale: 1.03, duration: 1.0, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); then gsap.to('.cursor', {x: btnX, y: btnY, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out'}, '-=0.2').
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 24], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translateX = -0.55 * width * p, scale = 1 + 0.03 * p; cursor position via spring({frame: frame - 18, fps, config: {damping: 200}}).

notes: Camera verdict is pan_right (content slides left). Hard to tell whether this is a true camera pan or the diff panel sliding in over the plan; treated as a camera pan per facts.json. All four SFX candidates are ambiguous against the music bed.
